what: One Crosstrainer session, NN_HFL (secure aggregation, certificate route), 2 clients (Site A and Site B text, each in its own silo bucket), 3 iterations, 2 local epochs per iteration, LoRA r=8 adapter-only exchange on the frozen OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT base. Site A's text has no MOBILITY example and Site B's has no CONGESTION example. The scored model is the highest-iteration global adapter.

target.metric: FAMILY accuracy of the final global adapter on the test set for the family each site never logged at home (Site A: MOBILITY, Site B: CONGESTION)
target.direction: both at or above 0.85, against local-only adapters at or below 0.35

also.metric: only LoRA tensors cross the boundary
also.direction: exchanged state holds 392 lora_* tensors (about 35 MB), no base weights and no text

model_id: OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (organisers' bucket) + LoRA r=8 alpha=16 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; ran-fl/taskb/model-code/model.py
grader: ran-fl/taskb/taskb_job.py (deterministic: log-likelihood ranking of the candidate FAMILY, CAUSE and ACTION; no model-written labels, no LLM judge)
not_claimed: Differential privacy is not applied to Task B (Opacus on a PEFT language model was out of scope for the deadline); the privacy-budget unit is demonstrated on Task A only.
